title: Pie or donut
text: Slices run clockwise from the top, with an optional donut hole and center label.

title: Printed shares
text: Percentage or value labels on slices large enough to hold them.

title: Keyboard slices
text: One tab stop; arrow keys move between slices with a tooltip.

title: Data table fallback
text: A generated summary and a table of category, value, and percent.

title: Not color alone
text: Textures, legend order, and labels as non-color cues.
